title: Multiplicative Colombeau algebras and the Nyman--Beurling criterion for the Riemann hypothesis
summary: This paper establishes an equivalence between the Riemann hypothesis and the association, together with uniform $L^2$-boundedness, of a moderate net in a Colombeau-type algebra built from polynomially damped Báez-Duarte sums. The regularization is performed by multiplicative (Mellin) convolution, which respects the dilation symmetry of the Beurling functions and guarantees that every approximant lies in the $L^2$-closure of the Beurling space.
